context:
Goal: the records describe the app as it is.
Problem (rule): decision ruled-head-masthead-vocabulary still describes head cells on the Packages and Tally lists. The web removed them; they now live in the Ledger tab's View group. Measure: unmeasured. The record protected one shared vocabulary for the head, which the sync-particulars record still protects.
Based on (record): decision ledger-tab-holds-options.
Departs from: main ruled-head-masthead-vocabulary says head cells sit on the lists — the rewrite says they live in the Ledger View group.
Meanwhile: restyle works on. Nothing waits on this.

options.how: The record says the head cells live in the Ledger tab's View group.
options.label: Rewrite the record in place
options.lose: Nothing; git keeps the old text.

options.how: The record keeps its current text.
options.label: Leave it

title: A record still puts head cells on the Packages and Tally lists, which the web removed. Rewrite it?
why: The cells moved, and the vocabulary the record protected is still protected by the sync-particulars record.
